# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

# PLot phylogeny 
```{r}
# Import tree
tr  <-midpoint.root(read.tree("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Phylogenies/CDC/Fastree_DP.tre"))

# Load metadata
serotypes <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC/Serotypes.txt", header=T)
CCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC/combined_results_with_cc.txt")
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Strain Typing/CDC/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)

# Load phenotypes
phenotypes <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/phenotypes_CDC.txt", header=T)
phenotypes <- phenotypes |>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(continuous<=7, "EOD", 
                          ifelse(continuous<=89, "LOD", "VLOD")))
# Prep metadata for tree
typing_data <- left_join(left_join(left_join(serotypes, CCs), SCs), phenotypes)
fewer5_SC <- which(table(typing_data$SC)<=5)
metadata_tree_v0 <- typing_data |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:12, "other")))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI", "VIII")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% tr$tip.label)
```

# 1. Main Analysis
# 1.1. SNP-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/SNPGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))
SNPGWAS_sig <-SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM |> 
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 /nrow(SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM))

# Load SNP distribution across samples
sig_SNPs <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Sig_SNP.txt")
sig_SNPs_df <- sig_SNPs  |> 
  select(- X.CHROM, -ID, -QUAL, -FILTER, -INFO, -FORMAT)|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1/1", .), 1, 0)))|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(4:1543), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / 1540, 3))|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))|>
  mutate(MUT= paste0(REF, POS, ALT), .before = 1)|> 
  select(-POS, -REF, -ALT)
df_t <- as.data.frame(t(sig_SNPs_df[,-1]))
colnames(df_t) <- sig_SNPs_df[[1]]

```
# 1.2. DB-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
DBGWAS_data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/DBGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)

# Load Annotations
DBGWAS_ann <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/DBGWAS_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F) 
colnames(DBGWAS_ann) <- colnames(DBGWAS_data)
DBGWAS_ann <- DBGWAS_ann |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)|>
  mutate(ref_accessory = ifelse(str_extract(notes, "^[^:]+")=="AP018935.1", "ref genome", "unaligned contig"),
         coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"), 
         start= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,1], 
         end= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,2],
         POS = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "^[0-9]+")),
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))  |>
  separate(
    notes, 
    into = c("contig_position", "upstream", "gene", "downstream"), 
    sep = ";", 
    remove = FALSE, 
    fill = "right"
  )

# Sig hits
DBGWAS_sig <- DBGWAS_ann |> 
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / 87899) |>
  mutate(ref_accessory = factor(ref_accessory, levels= c("ref genome", "unaligned contig")))|>
  arrange(ref_accessory, as.numeric(start))|>
  mutate(
    OR = exp(beta),
    OR_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f; %.2f)", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    P_value = formatC(lrt.pvalue, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) |>
  mutate(variant2= paste0("Unitig ",row_number()), 
         annotation= paste0("coord:", coord_range, "(", ref_accessory, "); gene: ", gene))|> 
  select(variant, variant2, af, OR_CI, P_value, annotation) 
DBGWAS_sig

# Load Unitig distribution across samples
Sig_Unitig <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Sig_Unitig.txt", sep=" ", header=F)|>
  select(-V2)
Sig_Unitig[] <- lapply(Sig_Unitig, function(x) gsub(":1", "", x))
order_unitigs <- DBGWAS_sig$variant
Sig_Unitig <- Sig_Unitig |>
  filter(V1 %in% order_unitigs) |>
  mutate(V1 = factor(V1, levels = order_unitigs)) |>
  arrange(V1)

Unitig_sig_t <- metadata_tree_v0 %>% select(label)
for(i in 1:nrow(Sig_Unitig)){
  present_samples <- as.vector(unlist(Sig_Unitig[i, -1]))
  new_var <- ifelse(Unitig_sig_t$label %in% present_samples, 1, 0)
  Unitig_sig_t[[paste0("Unitig_", i)]] <- new_var
}
row.names(Unitig_sig_t) <- Unitig_sig_t$label
Unitig_sig_t <- Unitig_sig_t[,-1]
round(colMeans(Unitig_sig_t %>% select(starts_with("Unitig_"))),3)
Unitig_sig_t <- Unitig_sig_t |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(. == 0, "absent", "present")))
```
# 1.3. Pan-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
PanGWAS_FastTree <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Population_Structure_Methods/FastTree_DP_LMM/PanGWAS.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)
 PanGWAS_FastTree_sig <- PanGWAS_FastTree |> filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / nrow(PanGWAS_FastTree))
 
# Load Gene distribution across samples
gene_presence_absence <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/COG_presence_absence.Rtab", header=T)
gene_sig <- gene_presence_absence |> 
  filter(Gene %in% PanGWAS_FastTree_sig$variant)
gene_sig_Sum_prop <- gene_sig|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(2:ncol(gene_sig)), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / (ncol(gene_sig)-1), 3))|>
  select(Gene, Sum, Proportion)
gene_sig_Sum_prop
gene_sig <- gene_sig |>
  mutate(across(2:1541, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))
gene_sig_t <- as.data.frame(t(gene_sig[,-1]))
colnames(gene_sig_t) <- gene_sig[[1]]

```

# What proportion of samples carrying one significant hit also carries another ? 
```{r}
df_complete <- left_join(left_join(left_join(metadata_tree_v0 , 
                          df_t |> mutate(label=rownames(df_t))) , 
                          Unitig_sig_t |> mutate(label=rownames(Unitig_sig_t))), 
                          gene_sig_t |> mutate(label=rownames(gene_sig_t))) 


df_complete_V2 <- df_complete |> select(-label, -GBS.SBG, -ST, -clonal_complex, -SC, -binary, -continuous, -Age_cat, -SC2, -Serotype2)

# Suppose `line` is your data.frame or matrix
sim_matrix <- matrix(NA, ncol(df_complete_V2), ncol(df_complete_V2),
                     dimnames = list(colnames(df_complete_V2), colnames(df_complete_V2)))

for (i in 1:ncol(df_complete_V2)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(df_complete_V2)) {
    sim_matrix[i, j] <- mean(df_complete_V2[, i] == df_complete_V2[, j])
  }
}

# Heatmap
library(reshape2)
sim_long <- melt(sim_matrix)
colnames(sim_long) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "value")
sym_palette <- c(viridis::plasma(100), rev(viridis::plasma(100)))
sim_long_tri <- sim_long[as.numeric(sim_long$Var2) <= as.numeric(sim_long$Var1), ]
library(ggplot2)
p_direction <- ggplot(sim_long_tri, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",       # Color for 0
    mid = "white",     # Color for 0.5
    high = "red",      # Color for 1
    midpoint = 0.5,    # Where the "mid" color should be
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "", y = "", 
    title = "Direction of Co-occurrence\nof GWAS-significant variants",
    fill = "Proportion of samples\nwith identical genotypes"
  )


# Suppose `line` is your data.frame or matrix
chisq_matrix_stat <- matrix(NA, ncol(df_complete_V2), ncol(df_complete_V2),
                     dimnames = list(colnames(df_complete_V2), colnames(df_complete_V2)))
chisq_matrix_p <- chisq_matrix_stat

n_pairs <- ncol(df_complete_V2)*((ncol(df_complete_V2))-1)/2
sig_threshold <- 

for (i in 1:ncol(df_complete_V2)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(df_complete_V2)) {
    chisq_test <- chisq.test(df_complete_V2[, i], df_complete_V2[, j])
    chisq_matrix_stat[i, j] <- chisq_test$statistic
    chisq_matrix_p[i, j] <- chisq_test$p.value
  }
}


# Heatmap
chisq_matrix_stat_long <- melt(chisq_matrix_stat)
colnames(chisq_matrix_stat_long) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "value")
chisq_matrix_stat_long_tri <- chisq_matrix_stat_long[as.numeric(chisq_matrix_stat_long$Var2) <= as.numeric(chisq_matrix_stat_long$Var1), ]
p_strength <- ggplot(chisq_matrix_stat_long_tri, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",       
    mid = "white",     
    high = "red",      
    midpoint = 0.05) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Genetic Variant / GWAS Signal 1", 
    y = "Genetic Variant / GWAS Signal 2", 
    title = "Strength of Co-occurrence\nof GWAS-significant variants",
    fill = "Chi-square test statistic\nfor co-occurrence of\nvariant alleles")


# Stack rows
p_direction_strength <- p_direction + p_strength 
p_direction_strength
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_linkage_heatmaps.png", p_direction_strength, width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_linkage_heatmaps.tiff", p_direction_strength, width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
